# Divine Home India

> Divine Home India is a serving tray manufacturer and wholesaler based in Karol Bagh, New Delhi. Since 2015 it has designed its own decorative tray prints and supplied complete tray collections, mango wood trays, ceramic snack and candy sets, leatherette organisers, crockery and corporate gift sets to 250+ dealers and 50+ distributors across India. It sells B2B: retailers, gift shops, distributors, hotels, cafés and corporate gifting buyers.

Key facts:
- Business type: designer serving tray and home decor manufacturer-wholesaler (B2B), with custom-branded and private-label trays for corporate, hotel and brand orders
- Showroom: 1st Floor, 15A/47, near Hotel Kyron, Block 15A, WEA, Karol Bagh, New Delhi 110005, India (near Karol Bagh metro)
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:30 am to 8:00 pm
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 84594 95594
- Serves: Delhi NCR (New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Ghaziabad, Faridabad) and pan-India dispatch by transport or courier
- Signature designs: Elegant Vector, Lotus Glow, Peachy Bloom, Peacock Grace, Bless Heart, Ikket, Marble Flow, Elegance Elephant (Ellite series, hammered metal rims); glass foil (Vintage Map, Mughal Garden, Red Mandala); mango wood (Peacock, Kalamkari, Egypt); Leather Classic
- Common tray sizes: 18x12 and 16x10 in rectangle and oval sets; 13x13 and 11x11 in square and round sets
- Trade prices and MOQ are shared on request
